threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Inventory are stretching year on year.
The price already embeds growth well above the delivered record.

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew -2% vs profit -12% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Management noted that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties and actual results may differ materially.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "This presentation may contain forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The ABS business is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations because key raw materials like Styrene and Acrylonitrile are import-dependent.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: Keeping low inventories of imported raw materials to limit price fluctuation risks can create operational limitations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The limitation arises out of deliberate decision on the part of domestic manufacturers to keep low inventories of its imported key raw materials which is more than 85% (i.e. Styrene and Acrylonitrile monomers) to limit the risk of price fluctuations which may..." (annual report - 2026-03-31)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
